name: Silly Season
author: Alex Sánchez
description: A living driver market for Career mode: rumours, talks, signings, retirements, sackings, press conferences, F2 and new talents, with inbox mails, breaking news and a market panel (F7).

options.label: Silly Season
options.description: Change this value to open each market report: news, rumours, done deals, next season's grid, contracts, free agents and history.

options.label: Press conference
options.description: When the press asks you about the market, pick your answer here (1, 2 or 3). Open the "Press conference" report first to read the question, or answer with F7.

options.label: Market intensity
options.description: Realistic: few, logical moves. Lively: more signings and surprises. Chaos: anything can happen.

options.label: Rumours
options.description: How many rumours appear each race weekend. Some are true, some are not.

options.label: Mid-season changes
options.description: Impatient teams can sack an underperforming driver mid-season and bring in a free agent the game lets race.

options.label: Stand-ins
options.description: Now and then a driver misses a race through injury or illness and the team calls up its reserve driver.

options.label: New talents
options.description: Every season invented young drivers with their own names arrive in F2, so the market never runs dry.

options.label: Press conferences
options.description: The press asks you about your future, your team-mate and the signings. Your answers shape the market.

options.label: Protect my team-mate
options.description: Your team-mate never changes. Your own seat is never touched.

options.label: Legends on the market
options.description: Senna, Schumacher, Häkkinen and other icons can return to the grid.

options.label: Market emails
options.description: A paddock insider writes to you every race weekend: a market preview before practice, a radar after the race and the new grid when the season closes. Applies after restarting the game.

options.label: Breaking news banner and panel (F7)
options.description: A breaking news banner appears with every signing, retirement or sacking. F7, or Back + Y on a controller, opens the market panel outside sessions.

options.label: Panel effects (F7)
options.description: Shadows, glows and animations in the market panel and the banner. Turn off for a lighter panel on slower PCs.

options.label: Pop-ups back at Team HQ
options.description: Which news also appear as a pop-up when you return to Team HQ.

options.label: Driver progression (experimental)
options.description: Every winter young drivers improve and veterans fade in the market's view (value, interest, cards). Only new talents' ratings are written into the game, which develops its own drivers.

options.label: Who runs the market
options.description: Silly Season (recommended): the game stops retiring and sacking drivers on its own. The game: its own moves run too and can clash with Silly Season's. Applies after restarting the game.

options.label: Driver personalities
options.description: Each driver is ambitious, loyal or after the money. It shapes who renews, who turns a team down, who asks to leave and how much a driver costs.

options.label: Team plans
options.description: Each team follows a plan: title push, contender, rebuild, youth or survival. It shapes who they sign and how patient they are. Off: the plain rules of 1.0.

options.label: Deadline day
options.description: The last two races before next season's grid is set: deals close fast, a surprise swoop can land, and the panel, ticker and banner count down.

options.label: Bombshell signing cards
options.description: When a star signs for a team at least as good as his, a full card shows the move instead of the usual banner.

options.label: Grid reveal
options.description: Once next season's grid is final, the next Team HQ visit reveals it team by team on a full screen. Press R on the Grid page (F7) to see it again.

options.label: Team HQ market card
options.description: A small card in a corner of Team HQ for a few seconds: unread news, the latest headline and the deadline countdown.

options.label: Racing numbers for new talents
options.description: New talents pick a racing number of their own when they reach F1. If another driver holds it, the next one is tried.

options.label: Living paddock
options.description: Sister teams swap drivers mid-season, sponsors come and go, prize money moves the budgets, and team principals can be sacked. Off: fixed budgets, no swaps, no new bosses.

options.label: Press questions on screen
options.description: When the press has a question, it shows at Team HQ with the three answers: press 1, 2 or 3 to answer, or F7 to read it in the panel.

options.label: Report after each race
options.description: Back at Team HQ after a race, a card sums up what changed: your value, new rumours, done deals and the teams following you.

options.label: Awards ceremony
options.description: When the season closes, the next Team HQ visit hands out the season awards one by one on a full screen.

options.label: Season cover
options.description: The first Team HQ visit of each season opens with its cover: every team's plan and the winter's moves.

options.label: Panel size (F7)
options.description: How big the market panel draws on screen. Small fits more on a laptop; large reads better from the sofa.

options.label: Academies and reserves
options.description: Teams sign young drivers to their academies and a reserve driver each winter, bring rookies in through their second or partner team (Racing Bulls, Haas) and call the best of them up for stand-ins.
